documentation.title: Korean report mirrors the English analysis
documentation.test: The package docs must include a Korean version of agent-loop-analysis.md with the same durable sections and code evidence.

steps.expected: The Korean report exists and contains translated sections for evidence, response stream, tool follow-up, sub-agents and agent jobs, queues and concurrency, initial instructions, and branch outcome.

steps.instruction: Inspect package docs indexes after implementation.
steps.expected: The Korean report is discoverable from the package README or related internals/testing docs.

documentation.passCriteria: The Korean document is present, faithful to the English report, and discoverable from package docs.

verification.title: Deploy still succeeds after adding the Korean report
verification.test: The repository deploy contract must still complete after the documentation-only Korean report is added.

steps.instruction: Run npm run deploy from the repository root after implementation.
steps.expected: The command exits successfully or records a concrete blocker.

verification.passCriteria: Deploy succeeds, or any failure is captured with specific command evidence.
